item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya adds baking soda to water at 20 °C in a steel tumbler at home. Some baking soda settles at the bottom and does not dissolve, even after stirring.

She then warms the mixture gently to 50 °C while stirring.

What will Priya most likely observe?

options.A: The undissolved baking soda dissolves, and more baking soda can dissolve at the higher temperature.
options.B: The baking soda at the bottom turns into a new compound when warmed.
options.C: Heating only warms the water; the amount of baking soda that can dissolve stays the same.
options.D: The undissolved baking soda floats to the top and forms a separate layer.
